full_list.title_en: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 物理信息符号回归揭示了粒子—界面动力学中的延迟振荡闭合关系
full_list.abstract: Particles settling through sharply density-stratified fluids exhibit transient dynamics that remain difficult to capture with classical buoyancy–drag models, including strong deceleration, prolonged retention near the interface, and, in some cases, apparent bouncing. Existing mechanistic models that reproduce parts of this behavior through the equation of motion rely on auxiliary artificial virtual-mass ODEs whose physical interpretation and predictive generality are limited. In this study, we demonstrate implementation of physics-informed symbolic regression (PISR) method, applied to high-resolution dataset of particle-tracking experiments across stratified interface, enabling a compact analytical closure for the delayed stratification-induced force acting on spheres crossing sharp density interfaces, replacing an virtual mass ODE and capturing complex transient dynamics. Using fully resolved position-time trajectories of spheres from water–salt and water–glycerol stratified experiments, the PISR framework is designed to select a delayed, exponentially damped oscillatory force closure that is consistent with physical mechanisms of interfacial memory, wake detachment, recoil, and viscous relaxation. The resulting force closure reproduces qualitatively and quantitatively key features of the observed sphere dynamics and improves reconstruction transient-rich cases relative to a virtual-mass-based baseline. More broadly, the study demonstrates how scientist-in-the-loop or physically-informed symbolic regression (SR) can assist physical-model discovery by combining fully resolved time series experimental data, dimensional and physical constraints, and physically interpretable analytical model selection. These results provide a practical modeling framework for sphere motion across stably-stratified density interfaces and illustrate the potential of artificial intelligence assisted SR for extracting compact, testable closures in complex fluid dynamics problems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 颗粒在具有明显密度分层的流体中沉降时，会表现出难以用经典浮力—阻力模型描述的瞬态动力学，包括强烈减速、在界面附近长时间滞留，以及某些情况下看似发生反弹的现象。现有的一些机理模型通过运动方程中的辅助人工虚质量常微分方程再现了部分行为，但这些方程的物理解释和预测普适性有限。在本研究中，我们展示了物理信息符号回归（PISR）方法的实现，并将其应用于分层界面中颗粒跟踪实验的高分辨率数据集，从而为球体穿越尖锐密度界面时所受的延迟分层诱导力建立了紧凑的解析闭合关系，取代虚质量常微分方程并捕捉复杂的瞬态动力学。研究使用了水—盐和水—甘油分层实验中球体完全解析的位置—时间轨迹。PISR框架旨在选择一种延迟的、指数阻尼振荡形式的力闭合关系，该关系与界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等物理机制相一致。所得力闭合关系定性和定量地再现了观测到的球体动力学关键特征，并且相较于基于虚质量的基线模型，改善了对瞬态特征丰富案例的重构效果。更广泛地说，本研究表明，科学家参与式或物理信息符号回归能够通过结合完全解析的时间序列实验数据、量纲与物理约束，以及具有物理可解释性的解析模型选择，辅助物理模型发现。这些结果为稳定分层密度界面中的球体运动提供了实用的建模框架，并展示了人工智能辅助符号回归从复杂流体动力学问题中提取紧凑且可检验闭合关系的潜力。

full_list.related_work: 它与团队的物理约束机器学习、主动学习和可解释模型发现方法在方法论上相近，但研究对象是流体颗粒界面，不是铁电或磁性材料。Hongyu Yu、Xin-Gao Gong 可借鉴其量纲和守恒约束构建材料动力学闭合模型，Hongjun Xiang 可用于有效哈密顿量降阶；Weibin Chu 的非绝热轨迹和 Ji-Hui Yang 的载流子输运也存在时间记忆与迟滞动力学的形式类比。

full_list.title_en: Thermo-Relational State Inference for Lithium-Ion Battery SOC Estimation under Dynamic Thermal Excitation

full_list.abstract: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation under dynamic thermal excitation is complicated by the time-varying relationship between terminal measurements and latent charge state. Existing data-driven estimators commonly append ambient temperature to the input vector or use it to reweight individual features, but rarely model how thermal evolution alters pairwise historical relevance. This study proposes a Thermo-Relational State Inference Network (TRSI-Net), formulating SOC estimation as thermally conditioned relational inference. Thermally Conditioned Affine Recalibration adaptively reconstructs latent electrical representations using ambient temperature, its temporal variation, and the surface-to-ambient thermal difference. A Thermal Relation Field combines relative temporal separation with pairwise thermal-state discrepancy and is embedded into Thermo-Relational Memory Attention to organize causal history. Global Relational Readout then aggregates the relation-enhanced memory for SOC regression. Evaluated on the Panasonic NCR18650PF dataset, TRSI-Net achieved an MAE of 0.47%, an RMSE of 0.56%, and an R² of 99.94%, reducing MAE and RMSE by 62.1% and 65.0%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline. Ablation results confirmed the contributions of thermal recalibration, thermo-relational modeling, relational-memory formation, and global memory aggregation. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling thermal-state-dependent historical relationships improves SOC tracking under dynamic thermal excitation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 动态热激励下，端部测量量与潜在荷电状态之间的时变关系增加了SOC估计的复杂性。本文提出热关系状态推断网络TRSI-Net，将SOC估计建模为热条件关系推断，并通过热条件仿射重校准、热关系场和热关系记忆注意力组织历史信息。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上，该方法取得0.47%的MAE、0.56%的RMSE和99.94%的R²，相较最强基线分别将MAE和RMSE降低62.1%和65.0%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在动态热激励下进行准确的荷电状态（SOC）估计较为复杂，这是因为端部测量量与潜在荷电状态之间的关系会随时间变化。现有的数据驱动估计器通常将环境温度附加到输入向量中，或利用环境温度对各个特征进行重新加权，但很少对热演化如何改变历史信息两两相关性进行建模。本文提出一种热关系状态推断网络（Thermo-Relational State Inference Network，TRSI-Net），将SOC估计表述为热条件关系推断问题。热条件仿射重校准模块利用环境温度、环境温度的时间变化以及表面与环境之间的温差，自适应地重构潜在电气表征。热关系场将相对时间间隔与成对热状态差异相结合，并嵌入热关系记忆注意力模块，以组织具有因果关系的历史信息。随后，全局关系读出模块对经过关系增强的记忆进行聚合，从而实现SOC回归。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上的评估结果显示，TRSI-Net取得了0.47%的平均绝对误差（MAE）、0.56%的均方根误差（RMSE）和99.94%的决定系数（R²）；与最强基线相比，MAE和RMSE分别降低了62.1%和65.0%。消融实验结果证实了热重校准、热关系建模、关系记忆构建以及全局记忆聚合各部分的贡献。这些结果表明，显式建模依赖热状态的历史关系能够改善动态热激励下的SOC跟踪性能。

full_list.title_en: Rapid and non-destructive identification of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces based on machine vision and deep learning

full_list.abstract: Aiming at the problems of missed detection and false detection caused by the small size, low contrast, and complex eggshell background texture of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces, a high-precision detection method based on an improved YOLOv8s model was proposed in this study. First, in the data preprocessing stage, ROI extraction and background normalization methods were used to effectively suppress conveyor belt texture and environmental noise interference, and enhance the visual saliency of contaminant regions.Second, in terms of network structure, an AIFI module was introduced to enhance the global interaction ability of high-level features, and combined with the EMA attention mechanism to adaptively recalibrate key features, thereby suppressing eggshell background noise. Meanwhile, a four-scale detection architecture integrating the P2 layer was constructed to improve the model's detection capability for micro-contaminant targets. The results show that the proposed image preprocessing method could effectively suppress complex background interference and enhance the distinguishability of contaminant regions, thereby providing more stable input for subsequent feature learning. On this basis, the improved AEP2-YOLOv8s model achieves 79.9% mAP@0.5 and 45.2% mAP@0.5:0.95 on the self-built dataset, which are 6.7 percentage points and 2.1 percentage points higher than the original YOLOv8s, respectively.This method can effectively improve the detection performance of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces and provides a feasible technical solution for automated egg sorting.

full_list.abstract: Flexible and stretchable electrodes are essential components for soft electronic devices that operate under repeated mechanical deformation. However, conventional metal thin-film electrodes often suffer from crack formation and electrical failure because of the mechanical mismatch between rigid metal layers and elastomeric substrates. In this study, we present a textured Si-assisted fabrication strategy for stretchable platinum nanotube (Pt-NT) network electrodes. Electrospun polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) nanofibers on a textured Si wafer were used as sacrificial one-dimensional templates for Pt sputtering, enabling the formation of Pt-coated fibrous networks with controlled electrical continuity. Increasing the sputtering time increased the apparent Pt coating thickness and reduced the sheet resistance, indicating the development of interconnected Pt pathways. full_list.title_en: A Novel Approach to Computing the Permanent Magnet Thickness in PMSMs
full_list.title_zh: 永磁同步电机中永磁体厚度计算的新方法
full_list.abstract: To address the low accuracy of empirical formulas and the time-consuming nature of finite-element (FE) parametric sweeps for permanent magnet (PM) thickness in permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs), a novel iterative approach for calculating the PM thickness is presented. The method first establishes a FE model using an initial thickness, extracts the leakage factor, reluctivity, and average air-gap flux density, and then iteratively updates the thickness using the calculation formula. A 1600 kW, 250 r/min U-shaped interior PMSM is taken as the test case for validation. The results indicate that the proposed method reduces the calculation time by about 75% compared to the FE parametric sweep method, and yields identical thickness results. Both electromagnetic performance analysis and prototype tests confirm that the proposed method enhances design efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, and is applicable to the fast calculation of PM thickness for PMSMs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 针对经验公式精度低以及有限元参数扫描计算永磁体厚度耗时较长的问题，本文提出了一种迭代计算方法。该方法基于初始厚度建立有限元模型，提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密，并利用计算公式迭代更新永磁体厚度。以一台1600 kW、250 r/min的U形内置式永磁同步电机为例，结果表明，该方法在保持精度的同时可将计算时间缩短约75%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 为解决永磁同步电机中永磁体厚度经验公式精度低以及有限元参数扫描耗时较长的问题，本文提出了一种计算永磁体厚度的新型迭代方法。该方法首先利用初始厚度建立有限元模型，提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密，然后使用计算公式对厚度进行迭代更新。本文以一台1600 kW、250 r/min的U形内置式永磁同步电机为测试对象进行验证。结果表明，与有限元参数扫描方法相比，所提出的方法可将计算时间缩短约75%，并得到相同的厚度结果。电磁性能分析和样机试验均证实，所提出的方法在不牺牲精度的情况下提高了设计效率，并适用于永磁同步电机永磁体厚度的快速计算。

full_list.title_en: Spatial configurations in rehabilitated social housing: a relational analysis of design patterns in Brazil
full_list.title_zh: 改造型社会住房中的空间构型：巴西设计模式的关系分析
full_list.abstract: The rehabilitation of vacant buildings in central urban areas constitutes a promising – yet still underexplored in Brazil – alternative for delivering social housing (SH) in a more sustainable and spatially integrated manner. This article aims to characterize rehabilitated buildings through design patterns, based on the theory of Christopher Alexander, which proposes solutions oriented toward enhancing architectural and urban qualities. Initially, patterns potentially applicable to this context were identified, forming a relational analytical framework: rather than being examined in isolation, they are analyzed in terms of co-occurrence, considering their combined effects and topological performance within the design structure of buildings. Subsequently, this framework is applied to a sample of ten rehabilitated buildings in Brazil, using architectural documentation and on-site visits. Data analysis was conducted through the construction of networks in VOSviewer, complemented by centrality metrics (Degree and Betweenness Centrality) to interpret their relational structure. The results indicate the presence of strongly connected design cores and patterns that perform articulating roles across different spatial scales, suggesting the existence of a recurring spatial grammar in the context of rehabilitation. Additionally, they show that the configuration of SH produced through rehabilitation tends to result from the articulation between constructive attributes, functional organization, collective spaces, and urban insertion. This analytical reading provides support for the formulation of design guidelines and the improvement of evidence-based public policies aimed at housing provision in central urban areas.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在巴西，改造中心城区闲置建筑是以更可持续且空间融合的方式提供社会住房的一种有前景但仍研究不足的途径。本文基于克里斯托弗·亚历山大的模式理论，构建关系分析框架，并通过共现关系研究设计模式在10座巴西改造建筑中的组合效应和拓扑表现。结果显示，建筑中存在联系紧密的设计核心以及跨越不同空间尺度的连接模式，表明改造社会住房中可能存在反复出现的空间语法。研究可为设计导则制定和以证据为基础的中心城区住房公共政策改进提供支持。

full_list.title_en: Robust Broadband Dielectric Bragg Reflectors by Sensitivity-Regularized Chirp: Transfer-Matrix Proofs and Computational Uncertainty Analysis
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Robust Broadband Dielectric Bragg Reflectors by Sensitivity-Regularized Chirp: Transfer-Matrix Proofs and Computational Uncertainty Analysis
full_list.abstract: Fabrication variability limits the degree to which broadband dielectric Bragg reflectors can realize spectra predicted by nominal quarter-wave designs. This work develops a sensitivity-regularized chirp strategy for one-dimensional dielectric reflectors and analyzes it with an exact transfer-matrix model, explicit perturbation identities, and reproducible uncertainty simulations. A ten-period high/low-index stack centered at 1550 nm is parameterized by a three-coefficient Chebyshev chirp, allowing the optical thickness of each period to vary smoothly while remaining close to the quarter-wave condition. The design objective combines worst-band reflectance, spectral ripple, local thickness sensitivity, and profile smoothness. Four analytical results establish unimodularity of the lossless layer matrix, flux-consistent reflection bounds, an exact derivative formula for the multilayer product, and a first-order reflectance perturbation inequality. Over 1400–1700 nm, the optimized design increases nominal minimum reflectance from 0.9481 for a uniform stack to 0.9725 while reducing aggregate local thickness sensitivity by approximately 37%. In 1,000 Monte Carlo realizations with independent 0.5% layer-thickness errors truncated at ± 1.5%, the fifth-percentile minimum reflectance is 0.9683, compared with 0.9391 for the uniform design, and the standard deviation of minimum reflectance is reduced by approximately 75%. The results show that modest, smooth departures from quarter-wave periodicity can improve both broadband floor reflectance and manufacturing tolerance without adding materials or layers. The framework is intended as a transparent computational design method for thin-film and integrated-photonic reflector engineering.

full_list.title_en: A Novel Material Nano-Scale Material Derived from Garlic Shell Integrated with Red Meat Samples

full_list.abstract: The study aimed to develop a novel garlic-shell-based nanofiber using electrospinning and to evaluate its effectiveness in enhancing the safety and shelf life of red meat coated with the fabricated nanofibers. The fabricated nanofibers (71.869 ± 52.830 nm) were characterized by Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, and Thermogravimetric Analysis (TGA). FTIR spectra of the fabricated nanofibers revealed a chemical structure featuring hydroxyl, aliphatic, and carbonyl groups, alongside active sulphur compounds such as allicin. The thermal mass loss of the obtained nanofibers was not significant at the cooking temperature of red meat samples. The treatment significantly suppressed the growth of pathogenic and spoilage microorganisms (p < 0.05). The nanofibers achieved a maximum log reduction of 0.885 for Escherichia coli by day 11. Salmonella typhimurium decreased by 0.66 log CFU/g in red meat samples treated with garlic-shell nanofibers compared with non-nanotreated red meat samples stored at 4°C. Besides pathogenic microorganisms, a significant suppression of Total Psychrophilic Bacteria was observed, ending at 5.10 log CFU/g compared to 6.30 log CFU/g in control samples (decline: 1.2 log CFU/g). On the other hand, the decline in Total Aerobic Mesophilic Bacteria growth was found to be 0.54 log CFU/g over an 11-day analysis period. The findings suggested that nanofibers fabricated from garlic shell, a kind of food waste, represent a promising, bio-based alternative for active food packaging, capable of enhancing the microbiological safety and extending the refrigerated shelf-life of red meat products. Thus, this novel application could play an important role in further food applications.

full_list.title_en: Multielement Characterization and Chemometric Evaluation of Commercial Tomato Samples
full_list.title_zh: 商业番茄的多元素表征与化学计量学评估
full_list.abstract: Tomatoes are among the most widely consumed vegetables worldwide and represent an important dietary source of essential minerals. In this study, the concentrations of eleven chemical elements (boron, calcium, copper, iron, magnesium, manganese, sodium, phosphorus, strontium, sulfur, and zinc) were determined in 49 commercial tomato samples by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES) following closed-block acid digestion. Element concentrations (mg kg⁻¹, fresh weight) ranged from 0.62–23.10 (B), 28.59–112.52 (Ca), 0.16–1.99 (Cu), 2.09–96.00 (Fe), 45.95–99.49 (Mg), 0.61–4.10 (Mn), 2.93–91.39 (Na), 95.48–365.41 (P), 0.02–0.76 (Sr), 70.87–199.91 (S), and 0.79–3.40 (Zn), revealing considerable variability in elemental composition among samples. Principal component analysis (PCA) of the autoscaled dataset showed that the first four principal components explained 69.09% of the total variance, revealing two major and largely independent patterns of elemental variation. The first was driven primarily by calcium, magnesium, phosphorus, zinc, manganese, and strontium, whereas the second was associated mainly with boron, sodium, iron, sulfur, and copper. Hierarchical cluster analysis (HCA) supported the PCA findings by separating both variables and samples into two principal groups while identifying several compositionally distinct samples characterized by unusually high concentrations of specific elements. Overall, the results demonstrate substantial variability in the mineral composition of commercial tomatoes and confirm the value of chemometric tools for interpreting complex multielement datasets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究采用电感耦合等离子体发射光谱法测定了49份商业番茄样品中11种元素的含量，发现不同样品的元素组成存在显著差异。主成分分析表明，前四个主成分解释了总方差的69.09%，并揭示了两种主要且大体独立的元素变化模式。层次聚类分析支持主成分分析结果，显示出样品和变量的两大分组，并识别出若干具有特定元素异常高含量的样品。结果表明，化学计量学工具有助于解析商业番茄复杂的多元素组成数据。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 番茄是全球消费量最大的蔬菜之一，也是膳食中必需矿物质的重要来源。在本研究中，采用电感耦合等离子体发射光谱法（ICP-OES），在封闭式消解装置中进行酸消解后，测定了49份商业番茄样品中11种化学元素（硼、钙、铜、铁、镁、锰、钠、磷、锶、硫和锌）的含量。以鲜重计，元素浓度（毫克/千克）范围分别为：硼0.62至23.10、钙28.59至112.52、铜0.16至1.99、铁2.09至96.00、镁45.95至99.49、锰0.61至4.10、钠2.93至91.39、磷95.48至365.41、锶0.02至0.76、硫70.87至199.91，以及锌0.79至3.40，表明不同样品的元素组成存在显著差异。对自动缩放数据集进行主成分分析（PCA）显示，前四个主成分解释了总方差的69.09%，揭示出两种主要且大体相互独立的元素变化模式。第一种模式主要由钙、镁、磷、锌、锰和锶驱动；第二种模式则主要与硼、钠、铁、硫和铜相关。层次聚类分析（HCA）支持PCA结果，将变量和样品分别分为两个主要组，同时识别出若干组成上具有区别的样品，这些样品的某些元素浓度异常偏高。总体而言，结果表明商业番茄的矿物质组成存在显著差异，并证实化学计量学工具对于解释复杂的多元素数据集具有重要价值。

full_list.abstract: Although the Kolbe-Schmidt reaction has been studied in industrial production for more than 100 years, it is surprising that the scientific research in the theoretical stage has not attracted enough attention. Theoretical research is indispensable for the guidance and deepening of industrial production. In this paper, the carboxylation reaction characteristics of 2, 4-di-tert-butylphenol and 2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol were effectively studied at the atomic scale for the first time. The results show that the reaction of tert-butylphenol and CO2 is an exothermic reaction, and the product of 2, 4-di-tert-butylphenol O− is more exothermic and more stable in structure. However, compared with 2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol O−, the energy barrier needed to overcome in the reaction process is larger. Therefore, in order to achieve a considerable rate and conversion rate, industrial production needs to be carried out at high temperature and high pressure. This study provides a strategic direction for further understanding and optimizing the industrial application of the Kolbe-Schmitt reaction.

full_list.title_en: Anthropogenic fibers contamination in the Antarctic sea urchin Sterechinus neumayeri and the scallop Adamussium colbecki from Terra Nova Bay, Ross Sea

full_list.abstract: The Ross Sea region, despite being the world's largest Marine Protected Area (RSrMPA), is increasingly subjected to anthropogenic pressure from microplastic (MP) and microfibers (MF) pollution. This study assesses MFs occurrence in two key benthic species with distinct feeding strategies sampled from Terra Nova Bay: the filter-feeding scallop Adamussium colbecki and the deposit-feeding sea urchin Sterechinus neumayeri. MFs were found in all the individuals analyzed for both species. Scallops exhibited a higher mean abundance per individual (5.6 ± 1.53 MFs) compared to sea urchins (2.6 ± 2.07 MFs). MFs were predominantly blue and black, with those found in scallops being longer than those in sea urchins, likely due to feeding behaviour as capture and fragmentation processes. Polymer characterization via FTIR microspectroscopy (µ-FTIR) identified representative fibers as cotton, which is consistent with materials used at nearby research stations and global transport patterns. Our findings confirm that MFs are pervasive in these Ross Sea benthic invertebrate species, with the amount in Antarctic sea urchins approaching that found globally in highly urbanized regions. Our study highlights how feeding strategies affect exposure pathways in Antarctic benthic invertebrates. Improving our understanding of MFs distribution and uptake in the Ross Sea will contribute to a more comprehensive evaluation of ecosystem status and resilience, supporting evidence-based management and conservation decisions within the RSrMPA.

full_list.title_en: Development of a Biomimetic Agarose–Calcium Lactate Gluconate Composite Scaffold for Trabecular Bone Regeneration
full_list.title_zh: 用于松质骨再生的仿生琼脂糖–乳酸葡萄糖酸钙复合支架的开发
full_list.abstract: Calcium-based biomaterials have attracted significant interest due to their high biocompatibility and resemblance to natural bone architecture. They facilitate direct bone ingrowth and integration with host bone, making them highly effective for bone regeneration and osteoconductivity. According to recent research, the use of calcium-based materials in tissue engineering has advanced substantially. The aim of this study was therefore to develop a novel three-dimensional (3D) scaffold using calcium lactate gluconate (CLG) and to examine its osteogenic potential. Agarose (3%) containing CLG (3%, 5%, 10%, and 15%) scaffolds were fabricated using the freeze-drying method. The physicochemical and morphological analysis of all samples was performed using field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX), Elemental mapping, X-ray diffraction (XRD), Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET), and MicroCT analysis. Characterization of the composite scaffolds revealed a highly biomimetic, highly porous scaffold architecture and exhibited enhanced compressive strength and elastic modulus compared with the Agarose control sample. The in vitro experiments conducted with human pre-osteoblast cells (MG-63) revealed that the fabricated scaffolds were well compatible and supported cell adhesion and proliferation, favoring the enhanced porosity of the composite scaffolds. The in vitro haemocompatibility test indicated that the composite scaffolds had significantly lower hemolysis and a better blood clotting index than the control. CLG scaffolds also demonstrated upregulation of osteogenic differentiation markers, as assessed by quantitative real-time PCR and the Alizarin staining method, respectively. The results indicated that the CLG-functionalized scaffolds are a suitable candidate for bone tissue remodeling and potential applications in bone regeneration.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文旨在利用乳酸葡萄糖酸钙（CLG）开发新型三维骨组织工程支架，并评估其成骨潜力。研究采用冷冻干燥法制备含3%琼脂糖和不同浓度CLG（3%、5%、10%和15%）的支架，并通过多种技术分析其理化性质、形貌和孔结构。复合支架表现出高度仿生且多孔的结构，其压缩强度和弹性模量均优于琼脂糖对照组。体外实验表明，支架具有良好的细胞相容性，能够促进细胞黏附、增殖和成骨分化，并具有较低的溶血率和更好的凝血指数。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 钙基生物材料因其良好的生物相容性以及与天然骨结构的相似性而受到广泛关注。它们能够促进骨组织直接长入并与宿主骨整合，因此在骨再生和骨传导方面具有很高的有效性。根据近期研究，钙基材料在组织工程中的应用已经取得了长足进展。因此，本研究旨在利用乳酸葡萄糖酸钙（CLG）开发一种新型三维（3D）支架，并考察其成骨潜力。研究采用冷冻干燥法制备含有CLG（3%、5%、10%和15%）的3%琼脂糖支架。所有样品均通过场发射扫描电子显微镜（FESEM）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、能量色散X射线分析（EDX）、元素 mapping、X射线衍射（XRD）、Brunauer–Emmett–Teller（BET）分析和MicroCT分析进行理化性质和形貌表征。复合支架的表征结果显示，其具有高度仿生且高度多孔的支架结构；与琼脂糖对照样品相比，复合支架表现出增强的压缩强度和弹性模量。使用人类成骨前细胞（MG-63）开展的体外实验表明，所制备的支架具有良好的相容性，并能够支持细胞黏附和增殖，而复合支架增强的孔隙率有利于上述过程。体外血液相容性测试表明，与对照组相比，复合支架具有显著更低的溶血率和更好的血液凝固指数。通过定量实时PCR和茜素染色方法对成骨分化标志物进行评估，结果显示CLG支架还能够促进成骨分化标志物上调。研究结果表明，CLG功能化支架是骨组织重塑的适宜候选材料，并具有应用于骨再生的潜力。

full_list.abstract: The proposed switched capacitor multi-level inverter can be utilized in photovoltaic, fuel cell, and battery systems to generate low harmonic content at output voltage. This topology, with the help of two sources, 9 switches, 9 drivers, 2 capacitors, and 2 diodes, can produce 11 voltage levels at its output. The advantages include voltage boosting, self-balancing of the capacitors, and higher voltage levels relative to components compared to similar structures. Furthermore, having switches that work at the low frequency of 50 Hz is an important advantage that can reduce switching losses. Due to the usage of the "nearest level" modulation scheme, the switches work at 50 Hz, which can lead to low total losses. In the proposed configuration, DC energy sources, such as photovoltaics and batteries, will be utilized as input sources. A comparison between the proposed topology and similar schemes has been made in terms of the number of levels, the number of switches, voltage gain, the ratio of voltage gains to the number of switches, and the ratio of voltage levels to all device numbers. The simulation results and experimental prototype of the proposed circuit have been practically implemented to prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

full_list.title_en: Pre-Fabrication to Post-Deployment: A Unified ML-Driven Pipeline for IC Logic Locking
full_list.title_zh: 从预制造到部署后：用于集成电路逻辑加锁的统一机器学习驱动流程
full_list.abstract: Every integrated circuit (IC) in the globally distributed semiconductor supply chain is a potential target for intellectual property (IP) piracy, reverse engineering, and hardware tampering. Logic locking is a widely adopted defense primitive, yet its effectiveness is constrained by three limitations: technique selection is largely manual and circuit-agnostic; static key-gate schemes are vulnerable to oracle-guided and structural attacks; and post-deployment security remains largely unaddressed. This paper presents a unified, four-stage machine learning (ML)-driven pipeline that addresses these limitations within a single automated framework spanning the complete IC protection lifecycle. A supervised Random Forest classifier extracts structural features from gate-level netlists and predicts the most appropriate technique from a portfolio of five classical locking schemes, achieving up to 97% prediction accuracy. Circuits are then secured either through fault-guided key-gate insertion or through STREAMLOCK, a lightweight stream cipher-based mechanism whose continuously evolving keystream replaces the fixed key-to-output relationship exploited by oracle-guided and structural attacks. Dynamic Partial Reconfiguration (DPR) then enables runtime key-gate updates on FPGA fabric without system interruption. Experimental evaluation across ISCAS'85 benchmarks confirms 100% functional correctness under the correct key. A three-way comparison among classical, STREAMLOCK, and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)-based locking demonstrates that STREAMLOCK achieves up to 9.3× lower Look-Up Table (LUT) utilization and up to 20.8× lower logic power than AES, while delivering cryptographically stronger protection than classical schemes. DPR integration introduces only a 5.92% increase in total power consumption and a 0.011% increase in LUT utilization. Together, these results establish a scalable and hardware-efficient IC protection pipeline.
full_list.abstract_zh: 针对集成电路知识产权盗版、逆向工程和硬件篡改风险，本文提出了覆盖完整保护生命周期的四阶段机器学习驱动统一流程。该流程利用监督式随机森林分类器从门级网表中提取结构特征，并在五种经典加锁方案中预测最合适的技术，最高预测准确率达到97%；随后结合故障引导密钥门插入或STREAMLOCK机制保护电路，并通过动态部分重构实现运行时密钥更新。在ISCAS'85基准电路上的实验表明，STREAMLOCK相较AES可将查找表资源占用最多降低9.3倍、逻辑功耗最多降低20.8倍，而动态部分重构仅使总功耗增加5.92%、查找表资源占用增加0.011%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 全球分布式半导体供应链中的每一块集成电路（IC）都可能成为知识产权（IP）盗版、逆向工程和硬件篡改的目标。逻辑加锁是一种广泛采用的防御原语，但其有效性受到三项限制：技术选择在很大程度上依赖人工且与电路无关；静态密钥门方案容易受到预言机引导攻击和结构攻击；部署后的安全性也基本未得到解决。本文提出一种统一的四阶段机器学习（ML）驱动流程，在单一自动化框架内覆盖完整的IC保护生命周期，以应对上述限制。监督式随机森林分类器从门级网表中提取结构特征，并从五种经典加锁方案组成的技术组合中预测最合适的方案，最高预测准确率达到97%。随后，电路通过故障引导的密钥门插入机制或STREAMLOCK进行保护。STREAMLOCK是一种轻量级流密码机制，其持续演化的密钥流取代了预言机引导攻击和结构攻击所利用的固定密钥到输出关系。之后，动态部分重构（DPR）使FPGA硬件能够在系统不中断的情况下更新运行时密钥。在ISCAS'85基准电路上的实验评估证实，使用正确密钥时功能正确率达到100%。对经典方案、STREAMLOCK和基于高级加密标准（AES）的加锁方案进行三方比较表明，与AES相比，STREAMLOCK的查找表（LUT）资源占用最多降低9.3倍，逻辑功耗最多降低20.8倍，同时能够提供比经典方案更强的密码学保护。DPR集成仅使总功耗增加5.92%，并使LUT资源占用增加0.011%。综合来看，这些结果确立了一种具有可扩展性和硬件高效性的IC保护流程。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《从预制造到部署后：用于集成电路逻辑加锁的统一机器学习驱动流程》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Geospatial Assessment of Urban Growth Patterns and Its Impact on Land Surface Temperature
full_list.title_zh: 城市增长模式的地理空间评估及其对地表温度的影响
full_list.abstract: The rapid urbanization strongly influences the land surface characteristics and aggravates the environmental problems, such as Surface Urban Heat Island (SUHI) effect. The present study focuses on the effect of urban growth pattern on Land Surface Temperature (LST) and precipitation variability in Dera Ghazi Khan, Punjab, Pakistan during 25 years, 2000-2025. The study combines the use of Remote Sensing (RS), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Google Earth Engine (GEE), and statistical modeling to analyze the temporal and spatial associations of Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) alteration with the thermal environment. The multi-temporal data from Landsat missions and Sentinel-2 datasets was used to categorize the study area into four major classes of LULC namely Water Body, Built-up, Agriculture, and Barren Land. Using a Random Forest machine learning classification model, the LULC map was created for six observation years (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2025). Spectral indices such as Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI) were derived to evaluate the vegetation density and urban expansion. The data for Land Surface Temperature was obtained by calculating using thermal infrared bands, and the data of precipitation was obtained from climate datasets included in Google Earth Engine. The Getis-Ord Gi statistic in ArcMap was used for spatial hotspot analysis, while Pearson correlation and linear regression analysis in Microsoft Excel were used to examine the statistical relationships. The outcomes showed significant urban growth for Dera Ghazi Khan during the study period. The extent of built-up land had grown from about 354 Sq. Km in 2000 to nearly 570 Sq. Km in 2025. The area of barren land decreased sharply and the area of Km increased. Results of the analysis showed that high built-up density and high NDBI values were correlated with high LST values. However, vegetation dominated agricultural areas and water bodies showed lower thermal signatures because of the effects of evapotranspiration and thermal inertia. There was also a variation in the average LSTs in the years 2015, with around 49°C, that was attributed to the precipitation variability, where years with higher precipitations also had better vegetation conditions and less thermal stress. The hotspot analysis revealed the spatial growth of thermal hotspots from urban core to periphery. The strong relationship between urban expansion and increase in surface temperature was further verified by statistical analysis. The results show that SUHI effect has been intensified to a great extent in an uncontrolled urbanization phenomenon and has changed the thermal environment of the region of Dera Ghazi Khan. The study offers a valuable scientific foundation for sustainable urban planning and adaptation to climate change in the fast-expanding secondary cities of arid and semi-arid areas. Geographical information systems (GIS) and statistical modeling are powerful tools for urban environmental change monitoring and evidence-based policymaking.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究结合遥感、地理信息系统、Google Earth Engine和统计建模，分析了2000年至2025年巴基斯坦旁遮普省德拉·加齐·汗城市增长模式与地表温度及降水变化之间的关系。结果显示，建成区面积约从354平方千米增至570平方千米，高建成区密度和高NDBI值与较高地表温度相关，而农业区和水体因蒸散和热惯性表现出较低热特征。研究认为，无序城市化显著强化了地表城市热岛效应，并可为干旱及半干旱地区快速扩张的中小城市开展可持续规划和气候变化适应提供科学依据。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 快速城市化强烈影响地表特征，并加剧地表城市热岛（SUHI）效应等环境问题。本研究聚焦于2000年至2025年25年间，巴基斯坦旁遮普省德拉·加齐·汗城市增长模式对地表温度（LST）和降水变化的影响。研究结合遥感（RS）、地理信息系统（GIS）、Google Earth Engine（GEE）和统计建模，分析土地利用/土地覆被（LULC）变化与热环境在时间和空间上的关联。研究使用Landsat系列任务和Sentinel-2数据，将研究区划分为水体、建成区、农业用地和荒地四个主要LULC类别。利用随机森林机器学习分类模型，研究为六个观测年份（2000年、2005年、2010年、2015年、2020年和2025年）建立了LULC地图。研究提取了归一化植被指数（NDVI）和归一化建筑指数（NDBI）等光谱指数，以评估植被密度和城市扩张情况。地表温度数据通过热红外波段计算获得，降水数据则来自Google Earth Engine中包含的气候数据集。研究使用ArcMap中的Getis-Ord Gi统计量进行空间热点分析，并通过Microsoft Excel中的皮尔逊相关分析和线性回归分析考察统计关系。结果显示，研究期间德拉·加齐·汗经历了显著的城市增长。建成区面积从2000年的约354平方千米增长到2025年的近570平方千米。荒地面积大幅减少，而某一类土地面积增加。分析结果表明，高建成区密度和较高的NDBI值与较高的LST值相关。然而，以植被为主的农业区和水体由于蒸散作用和热惯性而呈现较低的热信号。2015年的平均LST也出现变化，约为49摄氏度，这被归因于降水变化；降水较多的年份通常具有更好的植被状况和较低的热应激。热点分析显示，热热点在空间上从城市核心区向外围扩展。统计分析进一步验证了城市扩张与地表温度升高之间的密切关系。结果表明，在无序城市化现象下，SUHI效应在很大程度上得到强化，并改变了德拉·加齐·汗地区的热环境。本研究为快速扩张的干旱和半干旱地区中小城市的可持续城市规划和气候变化适应提供了有价值的科学基础。地理信息系统（GIS）和统计建模

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《城市增长模式的地理空间评估及其对地表温度的影响》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在分子动力学与有限温度轨迹、蒙特卡洛统计采样，并落到晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合、声子、有限温度和输运性质、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: Textured Si Wafer-Assisted Fabrication of Stretchable Platinum Nanotube Network Electrodes for Flexible Piezoelectric Devices
core_items.title_zh: 纹理化硅晶圆辅助制备可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极及其在柔性压电器件中的应用
core_items.abstract: Flexible and stretchable electrodes are essential components for soft electronic devices that operate under repeated mechanical deformation. However, conventional metal thin-film electrodes often suffer from crack formation and electrical failure because of the mechanical mismatch between rigid metal layers and elastomeric substrates. In this study, we present a textured Si-assisted fabrication strategy for stretchable platinum nanotube (Pt-NT) network electrodes. Electrospun polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) nanofibers on a textured Si wafer were used as sacrificial one-dimensional templates for Pt sputtering, enabling the formation of Pt-coated fibrous networks with controlled electrical continuity. Increasing the sputtering time increased the apparent Pt coating thickness and reduced the sheet resistance, indicating the development of interconnected Pt pathways. After thermal removal of the PVP template and transfer into polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), the Pt-NT electrode exhibited a low sheet resistance of 7.55 Ω sq− 1. Under mechanical deformation, the Pt thin-film electrode showed electrical failure during bending and failed above 20% tensile strain, whereas the Pt-NT electrode maintained conductive pathways even at 100% strain. The Pt-NT electrode was further integrated with a BaTiO3-PDMS piezoelectric composite layer, producing an output current of approximately 40 nA under an applied force of 25 N at 3 Hz. These results demonstrate that textured Si-assisted Pt-NT network electrodes can serve as deformable electrode platforms for flexible piezoelectric devices.
core_items.abstract_zh: 研究提出了一种纹理化硅辅助的可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极制备策略，以静电纺丝聚乙烯吡咯烷酮纳米纤维作为牺牲模板，通过溅射铂形成具有连续导电通路的纤维网络。去除模板并转移至聚二甲基硅氧烷后，电极的方块电阻为7.55欧姆/方，并可承受高达100%的拉伸应变，而传统铂薄膜在弯曲和超过20%的拉伸应变下即发生失效。该电极与钛酸钡—聚二甲基硅氧烷压电复合层集成后，在25牛顿、3赫兹外力下产生约40纳安输出电流，显示出其作为柔性压电器件可变形电极平台的潜力。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 柔性和可拉伸电极是软电子器件的重要组成部分，这些器件需要在反复机械变形下工作。然而，传统金属薄膜电极通常会因刚性金属层与弹性体基底之间的机械失配而产生裂纹并发生电学失效。在本研究中，我们提出了一种纹理化硅辅助的可拉伸铂纳米管（Pt-NT）网络电极制备策略。以纹理化硅晶圆上的静电纺丝聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）纳米纤维作为一维牺牲模板，通过溅射铂形成具有受控电连续性的铂包覆纤维网络。增加溅射时间会提高表观铂涂层厚度并降低方块电阻，表明互连铂导电通路逐渐形成。在热去除PVP模板并将其转移至聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）后，Pt-NT电极表现出7.55欧姆/方的低方块电阻。在机械变形下，铂薄膜电极在弯曲过程中出现电学失效，并在拉伸应变超过20%时失效；而Pt-NT电极即使在100%应变下仍能保持导电通路。随后，Pt-NT电极与钛酸钡（BaTiO3）—PDMS压电复合层集成，在25牛顿、3赫兹外力作用下产生约40纳安的输出电流。这些结果表明，纹理化硅辅助的Pt-NT网络电极能够作为柔性压电器件的可变形电极平台。

core_items.method_point: 该文给出较明确的实验工艺：以纹理化硅晶圆辅助静电纺丝 PVP 纳米纤维，溅射铂形成连续网络，去除牺牲模板后转移到 PDMS；电极方阻 7.55 欧姆每方，可承受 100% 拉伸，并与 BaTiO3-PDMS 压电复合层集成，在 25 N、3 Hz 下输出约 40 nA。摘要未涉及机器学习或原子尺度计算。
core_items.related_work: 这项工作与团队的铁电、压电、界面电荷和器件输运方向有关，但材料重点是柔性电极与复合器件，不是 ML 模型本身。BaTiO3 可连接 Hongjun Xiang 的极化和畴结构研究，Hongyu Yu 可建模缺陷与应变，Xin-Gao Gong、Ji-Hui Yang 可研究界面载流子与声子散射；Weibin Chu 可进一步分析机械激励下的非绝热电荷转移。
core_items.implication: 可将 BaTiO3-PDMS 复合层的晶粒取向、氧空位、应变和聚合物界面作为数据维度，用 DFT+U 计算极化、缺陷能级、界面电荷和声子，再以 MACE 或 NEP 模拟拉伸、弯曲和热循环。等变 GNN 可从微结构图像、网络连通性和有限元应变场预测方阻、压电系数及输出电流；用原位拉伸电阻、PFM、XRD、循环疲劳和不同频率载荷实验验证。

core_items.title_en: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics
core_items.title_zh: 物理信息符号回归揭示了粒子—界面动力学中的延迟振荡闭合关系
core_items.abstract: Particles settling through sharply density-stratified fluids exhibit transient dynamics that remain difficult to capture with classical buoyancy–drag models, including strong deceleration, prolonged retention near the interface, and, in some cases, apparent bouncing. Existing mechanistic models that reproduce parts of this behavior through the equation of motion rely on auxiliary artificial virtual-mass ODEs whose physical interpretation and predictive generality are limited. In this study, we demonstrate implementation of physics-informed symbolic regression (PISR) method, applied to high-resolution dataset of particle-tracking experiments across stratified interface, enabling a compact analytical closure for the delayed stratification-induced force acting on spheres crossing sharp density interfaces, replacing an virtual mass ODE and capturing complex transient dynamics. Using fully resolved position-time trajectories of spheres from water–salt and water–glycerol stratified experiments, the PISR framework is designed to select a delayed, exponentially damped oscillatory force closure that is consistent with physical mechanisms of interfacial memory, wake detachment, recoil, and viscous relaxation. The resulting force closure reproduces qualitatively and quantitatively key features of the observed sphere dynamics and improves reconstruction transient-rich cases relative to a virtual-mass-based baseline. More broadly, the study demonstrates how scientist-in-the-loop or physically-informed symbolic regression (SR) can assist physical-model discovery by combining fully resolved time series experimental data, dimensional and physical constraints, and physically interpretable analytical model selection. These results provide a practical modeling framework for sphere motion across stably-stratified density interfaces and illustrate the potential of artificial intelligence assisted SR for extracting compact, testable closures in complex fluid dynamics problems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 颗粒在具有明显密度分层的流体中沉降时，会表现出难以用经典浮力—阻力模型描述的瞬态动力学，包括强烈减速、在界面附近长时间滞留，以及某些情况下看似发生反弹的现象。现有的一些机理模型通过运动方程中的辅助人工虚质量常微分方程再现了部分行为，但这些方程的物理解释和预测普适性有限。在本研究中，我们展示了物理信息符号回归（PISR）方法的实现，并将其应用于分层界面中颗粒跟踪实验的高分辨率数据集，从而为球体穿越尖锐密度界面时所受的延迟分层诱导力建立了紧凑的解析闭合关系，取代虚质量常微分方程并捕捉复杂的瞬态动力学。研究使用了水—盐和水—甘油分层实验中球体完全解析的位置—时间轨迹。PISR框架旨在选择一种延迟的、指数阻尼振荡形式的力闭合关系，该关系与界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等物理机制相一致。所得力闭合关系定性和定量地再现了观测到的球体动力学关键特征，并且相较于基于虚质量的基线模型，改善了对瞬态特征丰富案例的重构效果。更广泛地说，本研究表明，科学家参与式或物理信息符号回归能够通过结合完全解析的时间序列实验数据、量纲与物理约束，以及具有物理可解释性的解析模型选择，辅助物理模型发现。这些结果为稳定分层密度界面中的球体运动提供了实用的建模框架，并展示了人工智能辅助符号回归从复杂流体动力学问题中提取紧凑且可检验闭合关系的潜力。
core_items.summary: 研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。
core_items.method_point: 该研究使用高分辨率颗粒轨迹、量纲约束和物理信息符号回归，针对颗粒穿越分层流体密度界面时的延迟分层诱导力，发现延迟指数衰减振荡型闭合关系，并解释界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫。摘要没有给出候选算子库、延迟阶数、稀疏化算法、训练样本量、噪声处理、外推范围或与基线模型的定量误差。
core_items.related_work: 它与团队的物理约束机器学习、主动学习和可解释模型发现方法在方法论上相近，但研究对象是流体颗粒界面，不是铁电或磁性材料。Hongyu Yu、Xin-Gao Gong 可借鉴其量纲和守恒约束构建材料动力学闭合模型，Hongjun Xiang 可用于有效哈密顿量降阶；Weibin Chu 的非绝热轨迹和 Ji-Hui Yang 的载流子输运也存在时间记忆与迟滞动力学的形式类比。
core_items.implication: 可把符号回归迁移到 NbOI2、HfO2 或 BaTiO3 极化翻转轨迹，数据由 DFT、NEP/MACE 长时间分子动力学和有效哈密顿量蒙特卡洛共同提供，输入局域极化、应变、缺陷电荷、温度和历史状态。候选闭合项应受空间群、时间反演和能量耗散约束，并允许记忆核；用留出温度、缺陷浓度和畴尺寸测试外推，最后以第一性原理力、畴壁速度、矫顽场和介电损耗实验验证。

core_items.method_point: 摘要说明该工作在超导电路中实现了八量子比特随机访问量子存储器，但没有披露电路拓扑、量子比特和谐振器参数、寻址协议、门序列、读写保真度、保持时间、串扰或误差缓解方法。标题和摘要也没有机器学习、铁电或磁性材料内容，因此不能补写神经网络架构、训练数据或材料计算设置。
core_items.related_work: 该成果属于超导量子信息器件，与团队关注的超导、量子功能材料和电子结构方法存在外围联系，但不是当前 ML × ferro/凝聚态主线。Ji-Hui Yang 可关联超导电子结构和电子声子耦合，Xin-Gao Gong 可研究器件界面缺陷与耗散，Hongyu Yu 可为量子器件材料开发机器学习哈密顿量；Hongjun Xiang、Weibin Chu 则可分别研究磁性耦合和非平衡激发噪声。
core_items.implication: 可将团队的缺陷和界面模拟用于超导量子存储器材料筛选：计算 Al、Nb、Ta、Si/SiO2 界面缺陷、TLS 形成能、声子耦合和介电损耗，使用 DFT、GW 或机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量生成训练集。再用等变模型预测局域结构到频移和退相干率的映射，结合电路量子动力学优化谐振器布局；以微波谱、T1/T2、读写保真度、串扰和温度依赖实验验证。

core_direction_note: 本日清单没有给出可核验的 ML × 铁电核心论文：明确涉及机器学习的主要是电磁屏蔽、钒基氧化物催化和符号回归，未报告 NbOI2、CrI3、CrSBr 或 BaTiO3 上的 equivariant GNN、MACE、NEP 或 DFT+U 结果。磁性器件论文推进了无外场自旋轨道力矩脉冲驱动，磁振子论文推进了室温关联微波源，但现有摘要不足以判断其是否使用机器学习。对团队而言，可将这些器件中的磁性异质结和 BaTiO3 压电层分别接入 DFT+U、自旋哈密顿量、MACE/NEP 分子动力学与等变哈密顿量模型，重点验证 CrI3、CrSBr 和 NbOI2 中自旋轨道耦合、极化畴结构及界面动力学。
